## Run mode

Not integrated. The code is the `strands-project` GitHub organization: dozens of ROS 1 repositories for the
2013-2017 long-term robot deployments, tied to the robot hardware and with no single entry point for the
service loop. See `docs/adding_a_case.md` to add an adapter.
